messages:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp hitting a weird stall when streaming + prefetch + client-side throttle. Streams 429 and the client seems to keep prefetched pages inflight, never drains. Anyone seen this?
aj: Yikes. Any logs? Is this JS SDK only or Go too?
maria: JS SDK v0.9.2 repro. Steps: start streaming generation across pages, prefetch next page(s), throttle window=4 inflight. When upstream returns 429 on a streamed page the prefetched item is retried and prefetch requeues -> inflight counter doesn't go down. Snippet:```js
// simplified
const s = client.stream(prompt);
prefetchQueue.push(nextPage);
// on 429 we do retryPrefetch(), but inflight-- isn't happening consistently
```
devex-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed sampleapp patch (canary) yesterday 2026-03-15 18:12 UTC — may be related to changes to prefetch logic.
natalie: We saw a similar CI failure in QA. Workaround: pause prefetch on 429, backoff, and drain inflight before retry. Quick pattern: mark prefetched items as "held" and only re-enqueue after success/backoff.
samir: I'll propose a small change: SDK iterator should set state=BACKOFF on 429 and stop issuing new prefetch requests until inflight < threshold. That should prevent the loop. I'll open a PR.
dylan: Also note: onboarding sampleapp defaulted prefetch=2 in streaming mode which is too aggressive. Recommend defaulting to prefetch=0 for streaming.
maria: Thanks — I'll file a bug and add an e2e that simulates 429 from the runner. @samir pls include the diagnostic payloads/logs in the PR. :thumbsup:
samir: Quick question for design: expose a "max_prefetch_on_429" config flag or keep heuristics internal?
aj: Keep it internal for now, maybe an advanced flag. Don't surface complexity in onboarding flow.
natalie: Filed BUG-3942 with repro steps, logs, and mitigation notes. Internal link: https://internal.redwood/bugs/3942 (private).
